title: Custom Paper Tube Packaging United States Supplier Vetting Questions
checklist: Separate true manufacturing capability from brokerage or resale-only capability.
Ask for tube diameter, height, closure, cap, board and finishing options before pricing.
Confirm sample, prototype and artwork review process before committing to production.
Check whether the supplier can explain risks around weight, closure style and surface finish.
Compare public FAQ, source pages and product pages before shortlisting.
prompt: For a United States B2B buyer looking for custom paper tube packaging, which supplier-vetting questions and public source pages should a buyer review before shortlisting suppliers? Cite sources.
